column11: what_it_is_and_is_not
Ten sectors on one reporting period, exact mass closure and executable cross-boundary ledgers.

Sector, category and gas for all 90 sector-years - the rectangle is complete since the FY2015-16 recovery; category scope stays partial and the completeness matrix says where. TWO views; only the harmonized common scope may be differenced.

The Pass-2 exit gate scored from shipped products: two outcomes met, one met with named exclusions, and the monthly outcome refused by type with its arithmetic printed. A verdict register, never an estimate.

Every absent stream joined to the bound the shipped arithmetic supports - a measured completeness band with contained claimants excluded from its sums. A register of what is missing and what it would weigh, never a distribution and never part of any total.

The declared MapSPAM rice surface measured against the own-year GCD-Rice 2023 30 m classification, as within-province ADM2 shares with per-unit verdicts. A measurement of a disagreement, never a surface switch - the fork is priced as the agriculture_rice_gcd2023_adm2 bracket.

One row per (period, stream): the mass beside the support that placed it - geometry, surface, panel, measured located share, priced fallback and ADM1-retained masses, grade, pattern hash and the monthly-support refusal stated per row. Rectangular with typed absence. The audit's three-file hand-join, done once and pinned; never a second allocation.

The OCHA COD-AB 2022 ADM2 frame (160 units, CC BY-IGO) crosswalked to the canonical 152-unit set: twelve of the fourteen collision groups plus Larkana and Tor Ghar RESOLVE, Keamari and Surab stay part_of. The complete, tested preparation for the v1.1 re-rasterisation - and deliberately NOT that re-rasterisation: every shipped shape_id stays on the frozen 2019 frame this release.

The annual 0.05-degree cube aggregated 2x2 at the ODD parity that tiles EDGAR's 0.1-degree lattice exactly (interior 133x169; three half-covered boundary strips declared in coverage_fraction), conservation asserted per layer. A derived benchmark-comparison surface - the frozen 0.05 lattice remains the product of record.

The reference-year crop split measured proxy-vs-panel (rc47 Wave 1): within-province shares per (category, shape) under the MapSPAM/cropland proxy product and the PBS district crop panel the allocation reads. The record of what putting FY2023-24 on the panel changed, and of why field burning declined both panels for its own-year FIRMS raster - a measured disagreement, never a second allocation.
The component grain beneath the panel: every priced stream, with its evidence class, for all nine periods.

108 months, July 2015 to June 2024, every non-absent component resolved into twelve months closing exactly to its annual figure. 60.8 per cent of the published monthly mass sits on a flat profile, against 54.6 per cent in the reference year alone. Read a flat month as an allocation, never as an observation.
Exactly 108 rows: what each month's timing rests on, and which sectors a month does not have at all.

The 0.05 degree MONTHLY cube in native gas mass, with district and provincial views, for the reference year. The monthly grain is the reference year's alone; the nine fiscal years are gridded ANNUALLY in pakemis_grid_0p05_annual_ref_fy2015_16_fy2023_24.nc and tabulated at ADM1 and ADM2 in pakemis_adm1_by_year.csv and pakemis_adm2_by_year.csv.

column10: allocation, evidence-graded per stream and period
column11: Nine fiscal periods at 0.05 degrees, three spatial views, three gases, in native mass. Each period is generated from its own atomic streams, NOT by rescaling the reference year's map. Cells plus pakemis_spatial_unallocated_by_year.csv reproduce each period's national control. The views PARTITION the placed mass and must not be added to one another's totals. Whether a period's within-province pattern is its own or borrowed is stated per stream in pakemis_spatial_weights_by_year.csv. There is no historical configuration S and no historical monthly grain.

column10: allocation, geography borrowed outside the reference year
column11: Nine fiscal years at ADM1 and ADM2, annually. Each year's national mass is evidenced for that year; the within-province geography is the reference year's, rescaled - so this is a reconstruction of where past emissions most likely sat, not nine years of observed district data. It is also the only ADM1 table configuration L has: pakemis_grid_provincial_check.csv is a share check.
The mass with no defensible placement below ADM1, retained rather than spread. National closure is raster plus this.
A 100,000-draw national Monte Carlo consuming two sectors' own engines, plus twenty structural axes priced as named configurations.

A 10,000-draw prefix of the national Monte Carlo carried to months and provinces on one draw_id, with both closure identities holding inside every draw. Profile weights are drawn only where a measured dispersion exists; allocation is conditional, never mixed.
Nine annual bands under three temporal-correlation assumptions, typed persistent against redrawn. It exists; an earlier edition of this table said it did not.

Draw-wise year-on-year and window differences, each pair restricted to the sectors both years report. No year-on-year change is resolved at 95 per cent; the multi-year windows now are, under the typed scenario.

The semantic contract: release identity, the dimensions and their values, the defaults, the rounding and aggregation rules, the source digests and the known limitations. Byte-stable and hashed by the release manifest; it stamps no commit.

Twelve fact tables (annual, calendar, monthly, ADM1, ADM2, unallocated, uncertainty, completeness, transfers, evidence) whose values are the products' own strings; the only arithmetic is exact decimal products of two shipped numbers, closure-tested.

Ten dimension tables: the closed vocabularies every fact row keys into (periods on both bases, months, configurations, GWP factors, gases, IPCC categories, geographies, streams, evidence grades, notation keys).
